name: border-beam
title: Border Beam
description: A traveling or breathing glow around any element: rotating beams (md, sm, line) and pulse halos (inner, outside), in eight palettes.
label: Libraries.dev
author: Jakub Antalik <https://github.com/Jakubantalik>

props.name: size
props.description: The effect: a full rotating border, a compact one, a bottom-only travelling glow, or a breathing glow inside or outside the element.

props.name: theme
props.description: Tunes opacity and blending for the background; auto follows the page, then the system.

props.name: active
props.description: Fades the effect in or out; onActivate and onDeactivate fire when the fade ends.

props.name: borderRadius
props.description: Overrides the radius measured from the child.

props.name: children
props.description: The element to wrap; give it a background (pulse-outside needs an opaque one).

a11y: Decorative: it adds no roles or text, and the wrapped element keeps its own semantics and focus.
Reduced motion: the rotating sizes hold still and only fade in and out; the pulse sizes do not animate (upstream's rule).
Loops while active: pass active={false} from a visible control when it plays next to reading content (WCAG 2.2.2). The demo's toggle is a native button with aria-pressed.
